a secret surfaces.text: A secret is a door kept shut inside a shared house, and this fear lives in the moment it opens. On the island of Baltrum, Alma sits up through the sleepless nights and [reads the diary Johan hides under the bed|1968-hour-of-the-wolf], until in the hour of the wolf he confesses. The same buried truth waits in Thurman, Texas, where [a father makes his boys help bury bodies in the rose garden|2001-frailty], and on the moors, where [Richard's father's journal tells of a son once offered to the spirit of nature|2023-starve-acre]. It is a rare trigger, found in a dozen films and in none made before 1960.

a special occasion.text: The day set aside for gathering is the day the doors stand open and everyone knows where to find you. On the eve of Antonio Bay's centennial, [a glowing fog rolls in carrying the drowned crew of the Elizabeth Dane|1980-the-fog]. In Chanderi, [men stay indoors after ten through a four-day festival|2018-stree], because a woman's spirit takes them and leaves only their clothes, and in a suburb of Dakar, [Omar's bed bursts into flame on Ada's wedding day|2019-atlantics]. The fear is missing before 1960 and comes in two waves, the 1980s and 1990s and the years since 2015.

a sudden accident or attack.text: Everything begins with one violent second that cannot be taken back. In Philadelphia, [Malcolm Crowe is shot in his own home by a patient he failed|1999-the-sixth-sense], and by the next fall he is carrying that wound to a frightened boy who sees dead people. Driving home from a party, [Jane runs over a young woman and Tun keeps her in the car|2004-shutter], and soon pale faces surface in his photographs; in a Moldavian crypt, [a travelling doctor lets drops of his blood fall on the witch's corpse|1960-black-sunday], and Asa wakes. Rare before 1960, it peaks in the 1980s and 1990s.

an outsider reaches in.text: A stranger at the door asks for something small, and ordinary life gives way around the request. At a lakefront holiday home in Austria, [a polite young man comes to the kitchen to borrow eggs|1997-funny-games], and by nightfall the family are hostages. In Antarctica, [the men take in a sled dog chased by a Norwegian helicopter|1982-the-thing], and it can become anything it touches, and in Blackeberg, [Eli moves in next door and one day asks to be invited in|2008-let-the-right-one-in]. Found in sixty films, it is common in every era and strongest in Southeast Asia and Continental Europe.

being spurned or shamed.text: Rejection lands first as a wound and then as a debt someone means to collect. In The Loved Ones, [Brent politely turns down Lola's invitation to the school formal|2009-the-loved-ones] and wakes bound to a chair in her house, decorated like a dance hall; passed over for Kudret's happy marriage, [Öznur turns to black magic and sets jinn upon Nisa|2014-siccin], and in Guatemala, [a dictator convicted of genocide goes free|2019-la-llorona], and at night he hears a woman weeping. The fear barely registers before 2000, then rises sharply, and the UK and Ireland carry far more than their share.

breaking a rule.text: Someone always says don't, and someone always does. On the boardwalk at Santa Carla, [Michael ignores Star's warning and drinks from a bottle of blood|1987-the-lost-boys], and soon his reflection begins to fade; in Adelaide, [a party game with an embalmed hand allows each guest ninety seconds|2022-talk-to-me], and then Jade's little brother Riley takes his turn. Beneath a stone labyrinth in Francoist Spain, [Ofelia's task brings her to the lair of the Pale Man|2006-pan-s-labyrinth], a monster that eats children. Common in every era, it is most frequent in the films of 2000 to 2014.

bringing something home.text: The harm arrives in someone's own hands, carried in like a lucky find. On a bus, [Joy Ramirez finds a bagua mirror and hangs it at her front door|2004-feng-shui], and every stroke of good fortune that follows costs a soul, and a nurse preparing a body for burial [slips a valuable ring from the corpse|1963-black-sabbath]. Years after her parents died, [Kaylie Russell brings the antique mirror back to the family house|2013-oculus] and rigs an anchor to smash it. It is one of the oldest triggers in the record, at its strongest before 1960, and it runs deep in Continental Europe.

calling on unseen powers.text: Someone reaches past the edge of the world, and for a moment something reaches back. In a rented Georgetown house, [Regan finds a spirit board and talks with Captain Howdy|1973-the-exorcist], and soon her bed begins to shake; in a remote cabin, [Eric reads the old book's incantation aloud|2013-evil-dead], and the thing that takes Mia needs five souls. At midnight on her wedding night, [Grace draws Hide-and-Seek from a puzzle box|2019-ready-or-not], and her new in-laws take up weapons. The fear comes in waves, strong in the 1980s and 1990s and again since 2015, and it is especially rich in Australian films.

cut off and trapped.text: The road ends, the line goes dead, and the only shelter on offer belongs to someone else. A rainstorm forces Marion Crane [to stop at the secluded Bates Motel|1960-psycho], where Norman talks over supper about the private traps people long to escape. Deep in an Appalachian cave, [a tunnel collapses behind Sarah and her friends|2005-the-descent], and Juno admits no rescue party could find them, and on a South Seas island, [Dr. Moreau destroys the only boat|1932-island-of-lost-souls]. It holds steady in every era and weighs heaviest in Sub-Saharan Africa, where two of the four films carry it.

digging into a mystery.text: The urge to know pulls the curious into rooms they would be wiser to leave. [Dr John Markway gathers a few guests at Hill House|1963-the-haunting], a mansion of skewed angles where something pounds at the bedroom door at night. Professor Philip Goodman, [who has built a career debunking psychics|2017-ghost-stories], is handed three cases by his long-vanished boyhood hero, and in 1905, [Thomas Richardson poses as a convert|2018-apostle] to reach the Welsh island where a cult holds his sister. Rare before 1960, it gathers from the 1980s onward and leans toward the UK and Ireland.

disaster strikes.text: Catastrophe arrives from outside, and every ordinary rule of safety falls away at once. On the express from Seoul, [a scraped-up woman slips aboard just before departure|2016-train-to-busan], and soon every bite turns another passenger while Seok-woo tries to keep his daughter Su-an alive. In 1980s Tehran, [a missile strikes Shideh's building|2016-under-the-shadow], the neighbours flee, and mother and daughter are left alone with a tale of djinn. Dawn of the Dead and The Mist carry it too, though it is rare, and it vanishes entirely from the films of the 1980s and 1990s.

going back home.text: Home is meant to take you back as you were, and here it remembers far too much. Thirty years on, [Laura returns to the closed orphanage where she grew up|2007-the-orphanage], and her son Simón finds a friend in a sack mask; in Kwaidan, [a poor swordsman comes home to the wife he abandoned|1964-kwaidan], to a tender welcome that does not last until morning. [Lena finds her husband Kane at home|2018-annihilation] a year after he vanished into the Shimmer, and soon he is gravely ill. The fear is unusually strong in South Asia, where six of sixteen films carry it.

losing family.text: Grief opens a gap in the household, and something moves in to fill it. After Mawarni dies of a long illness and her family sinks into debt, [her pale shape walks the house at night|2017-satan-s-slaves], and in Paris, [Maureen waits for a sign from her dead twin brother|2016-personal-shopper], as they promised each other before his heart gave out. On their California ranch, [OJ and Em lose their father to a nickel falling out of the sky|2022-nope]. The fear has grown steadily across the century, and nearly half its films were made since 2015.

love and desire.text: Desire makes people reckless, and the one they reach for is seldom who they seem. After meeting Oliver at the Central Park Zoo, [Irena marries him but never consummates the marriage|1942-cat-people], and her jealousy follows Alice into a basement pool; [widower Aoyama stages a fake casting call to find a new wife|1999-audition] and is enchanted by Asami, in whose bare apartment a large sack moves. In The Untamed, [a tentacled creature in a barn gives Veronica a pleasure no man can match|2016-the-untamed]. It fades in the 2000s, then returns strongly after 2015, with a large share in Continental Europe.

making a new home.text: The new place promises a fresh start and has already decided otherwise. A year after a family was shot at 112 Ocean Avenue, [George and Kathy Lutz move in|1979-the-amityville-horror], and George wakes every night at 3:15, and [Manohar moves his large family into apartment 13B|2009-13b], where milk curdles daily and the lift works for everyone but him. In an abandoned palace in Allahabad, [Hari Shankar sees a fallen photograph that bears his own face|1949-mahal]. The most common trigger of all, it is rare before 1960 and steady ever since, and it is especially strong in South Asia.

need and greed.text: Want drives people toward the very thing that will eat them. In the rain-cursed village of Tumbbad, [Vinayak lowers himself on a rope to steal gold coins|2018-tumbbad] from a starving god, with a dough doll for bait; Maya, [a Jakarta tollbooth worker hoping to sell an inheritance|2019-impetigore], follows an old photograph to a village where babies are born without skin. Broke and stubborn, [OJ and Em set out to catch the thing in the cloud on camera and sell the shot|2022-nope]. Almost absent for decades, the fear surges after 2015, when more than half its films were made.

playing god.text: This is the fear of the clever hand that tampers with life or mind: the experiment that works too well, the drug taken without knowing its price. It runs from [Henry Frankenstein raising a stitched body into a lightning storm|1931-frankenstein] through The Fly, in both its 1958 and 1986 versions, to [Herbert West reviving Dan's dead cat Rufus|1985-re-animator] and [Sue emerging from a slit in Elisabeth Sparkle's back|2024-the-substance]. It belongs almost entirely to North America, which holds thirteen of its sixteen films, and it is at its strongest before 1960, when five of the record's forty-one films carry it.

running from trouble.text: Flight feels like escape until the road sets the runner down somewhere worse. Marion Crane [steals $40,000 from her employer and drives off towards her boyfriend|1960-psycho], until a rainstorm leaves her at the Bates Motel and a shadowy figure finds her in the shower. The same urge to get away, whether from danger, punishment or eviction, carries [Cecilia Kass out of her controlling partner's house in the night|2020-the-invisible-man] and [Bol and Rial across the Channel to a shabby house outside London|2020-his-house]. Rare in every earlier era, it gathers pace after 2015, which holds seven of its fifteen films.

saying yes to an offer.text: The invitation arrives warmly, and accepting it feels like good manners or good luck. [Chris travels upstate for a weekend with Rose's family|2017-get-out], whose warmth never quite rings true; in Ugetsu, [Lady Wakasa orders pottery for her mansion|1953-ugetsu] and draws the potter Genjūrō into marriage. [Miss Giddens takes her first post as governess at Bly|1961-the-innocents] on condition that she never troubles the children's uncle. Strong before 1960 and again since 2015, it travels widely, from the UK and Ireland to Southeast Asia.

seeing or hearing too much.text: Some things should never be watched, and the watching is what marks you. In a resort cabin in Izu, [Reiko plays the tape, the phone screeches, and her seven days begin|1998-ringu], and in a Pennsylvania attic, [Ellison Oswalt finds Super 8 reels of families being murdered|2012-sinister] and watches them night after night. In Coming Soon, [the take in which the actress's safety sling snapped is left in the released film|2008-coming-soon], and Shane and Som have already seen it. Absent before 1960, the fear swells through the 1980s, 1990s and early 2000s, then eases.

someone goes missing.text: A gap opens where a person used to be, and the search for them leads into the dark. In Derry, [a small boy chasing a paper sailboat meets a clown in the storm drain|2017-it], and a summer later his brother Bill learns children have vanished there for centuries. In 1630s New England, [baby Samuel vanishes in his sister Thomasin's care|2015-the-witch], and after a quarrel at the opening party, [Simón disappears and Laura searches for months|2007-the-orphanage]. Long a minor fear, it surges after 2015, when more than half its films appear.

strange signs and visions.text: The warning comes as a dream, a glimpse or a voice, and it is hard to tell a message from a threat. In Venice, [a blind old woman sees the Baxters' drowned daughter Christine|1973-don-t-look-now] and warns that John is in danger, while he keeps glimpsing a small figure in a red coat. On Elm Street, [Tina is slashed in her sleep and the wounds follow her out of the dream|1984-a-nightmare-on-elm-street], and in Philadelphia, [Cole confides to Malcolm that he sees dead people|1999-the-sixth-sense]. Absent before 1960, it peaks in the early 2000s.

the body changing.text: The body becomes a stranger, changing on its own schedule and taking the self along with it. At an all-girls school in Malaysia, [Zaffan's first period arrives and her nails start to fall away|2023-tiger-stripes], while a pink-eyed jungle woman from an old warning tale appears to her alone. In a small Brazilian town, [the undertaker Zé do Caixão kills his barren wife|1964-at-midnight-i-ll-take-your-soul], believing only in the continuity of his own blood. Rosemary's Baby, Carrie and Ginger Snaps carry it too, and it is strongest in the 1960s and 1970s, with six of its thirteen films.

travelling somewhere remote.text: The journey carries people past the last place anyone could hear them call. In 1838, [Thomas Hutter travels deep into the Carpathians to sell a house to Count Orlok|1922-nosferatu], whose host lingers over a portrait of Hutter's wife. On Valentine's Day 1900, [the girls of Appleyard College picnic beneath Hanging Rock|1975-picnic-at-hanging-rock], both watches stop at noon, and three girls walk in a trance into a crevice; in the Australian outback, [Beth Winters films wildlife hunted for pet food and disappears|1984-razorback]. Common in every era, it leans toward Europe, North America and Australia.

unsealing what was shut away.text: Some things were shut away for a reason, and the hand that opens them rarely knows it. In a Moldavian crypt, [a travelling doctor breaks the glass and the cross over Asa's tomb|1960-black-sunday], and in Cambridge, [activists free a chimpanzee infected with rage|2002-28-days-later], and within seconds the virus leaps to them. In a rural town, [Pedro and Jaime find a disembowelled corpse in the woods|2023-when-evil-lurks], then a man carrying a demon waiting to be born. It holds steady in every era, and Latin America and South Asia carry more than their share.
